text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
After this... We're doing a few laps at 
70% max effort, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's keep your heart rate up high.
Yeah, let's keep that heart rate high.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"To increase maximum oxygen intake and 
improve endurance"...
choice_data_list: ああ、高い脈拍を維持しよう
うん、高い脈拍を維持しよう
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, let's keep your heart rate up.
Yeah, let's keep your heart rate up.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Understood! By the way, isn't that number 
of reps a bit vague?
choice_data_list:
I want to adjust accordingly based on the 
numbers and how you're doing.

I want to adjust accordingly based on the 
numbers and how you're doing.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, that would be more efficient. In 
that case... are you sure it's alright to 
leave it to you?
choice_data_list: 数値と、君の様子を見て適宜調整したい
数値と、貴方の様子を見て適宜調整したい
choice_data_list_en: I'd like to adjust things as needed based on the numbers and how you're doing.
I'd like to adjust things as needed based on the numbers and how you're doing.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Then I'm counting on you! I'll 
focus on swimming!
choice_data_list: ああ。ちゃんと見ているから！
うん。ちゃんと見ているから！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah. I'll be watching you the whole time!
Yeah. I'll be watching you every step of the way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training with Almond Eye was progressing 
smoothly. Communication between us was 
going better than ever before... or so I 
felt.
choice_data_list:
(Her body is getting even stronger, 
and...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We'll keep an eye on her for a bit longer, 
but entering real races starting in the 
Classic year shouldn't be an issue. If so, 
what we ought to decide soon is—
choice_data_list: （体も更に強くなってきているし……）
choice_data_list_en: (Her body's gotten even stronger, too...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Even further beyond the Shinzan Kinen... 
You mean her 'major goal' for the Classic 
year, right?"
choice_data_list:
What suits you best is most likely medium 
distance.

What suits you best is likely medium 
distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, looking back at the data, she 
seems quite versatile. In that case, the 
orthodox Classic Triple Crown or Tiara 
routes—
choice_data_list: 君に最も適しているのは、恐らく中距離だ
貴方に最も適しているのは、恐らく中距離
choice_data_list_en: What suits you best is probably medium distance.
What suits you best is likely medium distance.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The Classic Triple Crown route, or 
the Tiara route...
choice_data_list: どちらの三冠だって成せる……！
choice_data_list_en: You can achieve either Triple Crown...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Late starts, races... I was always 
focused purely on what was right in front 
of me.
choice_data_list: ……まだ、決まらなさそうか？
……まだ、決まらなさそう？
choice_data_list_en: ...Still having trouble deciding?
...Still having trouble deciding?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“Still, my criteria for choosing is set in 
stone. A race that makes me truly want to 
'win'!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I remember having a conversation like that 
before. In other words, if we can just 
find something that truly moves her heart—
—Mind if I squeeze past ya for a second?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me for interrupting your chat. I 
went and left my towel right over there.
choice_data_list: (This girl is—Lucky Lilac.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Graceful in demeanor, carrying an air of 
composure. This girl from Almond Eye's 
generation was—
choice_data_list: （この子は――ラッキーライラック）
choice_data_list_en: (This girl is—Lucky Lilac.)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac has completely broken away! 
With a burst of speed distinctly different 
from the rest! Crossing the finish line 
over a length ahead of 2nd place!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... Thank you all very much for your 
cheers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unshaken even while jostled in the pack, 
she claimed her brilliant debut victory 
with a model-student run, showing both 
courage and sharp race sense to find a 
clear path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She continued to run solidly after that, 
even winning graded races right away. She 
is currently one of the most anticipated 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well, thanks for having me. ...See you in 
class, Ai-san.
choice_data_list:
(Come to think of it, aren't those two in 
the same class?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Lala looks like she's gained a bit of 
muscle. Her gait looks different."
choice_data_list: （そういえば、ふたりは同じクラスだっけ）
choice_data_list_en: (Oh, right, those two are in the same class, aren't they?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Would it be all right if I 
watched her training for a bit?
choice_data_list: Yeah, no problem at all.
Yeah, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Well, shall we get going?
choice_data_list: ああ、構わないよ
うん、構わないよ
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, I don't mind.
Yeah, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...... Pace keeping: flawless.

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! Hey. Take a look over there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are currently seven Umamusume who 
have achieved the Classic Triple Crown. 
She is the newest "sovereign" among them. 
Due to her haughty demeanor, she is known 
as the "Tyrant."
choice_data_list: （“暴君”オルフェーヴル……！）
choice_data_list_en: (The 'Tyrant', Orfevre...!)

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She's watching Lucky Lilac... So those 
rumors were true after all.

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Being personally scouted out by that 
Orfevre... Well, she definitely has the 
talent for it.

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
The Hanshin Juvenile Fillies is next, 
right? A Junior Class GⅠ leading into the 
Tiara route... I wonder if the 
generation's first GⅠ will belong to that 
girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Paying no mind to the Trainers' gossip, 
Almond Eye intently watches Lucky Lilac's 
training.
choice_data_list: ...Are you really that curious about her?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Even before I contracted with you, I 
had watched her run many times."
choice_data_list: ……彼女が、そんなに気になる？
choice_data_list_en: ...Are you really that curious about her?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
She's serious, listens well to her 
teachers... She's a girl who can handle 
anything flawlessly!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
There were even plenty of times when Lala 
served as our role model. Even so, 
compared to back then—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: She has grown even more now. ...
choice_data_list: Ai?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Would it be alright if I went to 
watch the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies?
choice_data_list: アイ？
choice_data_list_en: Ai?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I was a bit surprised. Because I 
thought Almond Eye would say she 'wants to 
face off.'"
choice_data_list:
Of course that's fine, but are you sure 
you just want to observe?

Of course that's fine, but are you sure

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I think I understand my situation. My 
condition is improving, but...
choice_data_list: もちろん大丈夫だけど、見学でいいのか？
もちろん大丈夫だけど、見学でいいの？
choice_data_list_en: Of course that's fine, but are you sure you just want to watch?
Of course that's fine, but are you sure you just want to watch?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's why we can't afford to push 
ourselves too hard. The Shinzan Kinen is 
in January, which would leave very little 
turnaround time between races.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: That's why.........

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ............Just watching is fine!
choice_data_list: (You held out so well, Ai! Good job!)
(You did so well to endure it, Ai!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was decided that we would go watch the 
Hanshin Juvenile Fillies to see Lucky 
Lilac run.
choice_data_list: （耐えて偉いぞ、アイ！）
（耐えて偉いよ、アイ！）
choice_data_list_en: (Way to hang in there, Ai!)
(Good job hanging in there, Ai!)
